# benthepythondev RapidAPI Developer Integration Kits

> OpenAPI 3.1 specs, cURL/Python/Node snippets, 1-click n8n templates, and MCP tool definitions for public social media and job search APIs on RapidAPI.

## API Reference Pages
- [Facebook Posts Scraper API](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/facebook-posts-scraper2/): Facebook posts scraper for public pages and profiles: text, date, reactions by type, comments, shares, video views, pictures, video and link of every post, newest first. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON. (OpenAPI 3.1: https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/facebook-posts-scraper2/openapi-3.1.json)
- [TikTok Profile Scraper API](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/tiktok-profile-scraper2/): Returns one row per TikTok profile: exact followers, following, likes and video count, bio, bio link, verified badge, business category, region and the latest videos with play counts, posting rate and last post date. Up to 5 results per request, as JSON. (OpenAPI 3.1: https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/tiktok-profile-scraper2/openapi-3.1.json)
- [Instagram Profile Scraper API](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/instagram-profile-scraper10/): Instagram profile API without login: send up to 5 usernames, @handles or profile links per request and get followers, following, full name, bio, the real destinations of the bio links, verified and private flags, pronouns, profile picture and the linked Threads account, as JSON. (OpenAPI 3.1: https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/instagram-profile-scraper10/openapi-3.1.json)
- [Job Search API (Indeed, LinkedIn, Reed, ATS Boards)](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/job-search-api-indeed-linkedin-reed-seek-and-ats-boards/): Job postings from Indeed, LinkedIn, Reed, Seek, Wellfound, Welcome to the Jungle and the career pages of companies on Greenhouse, Workday and other applicant tracking systems, in one API. (OpenAPI 3.1: https://benthepythondev00.github.io/api-kits/job-search-api-indeed-linkedin-reed-seek-and-ats-boards/openapi-3.1.json)
